findings.quote: The village fountain was in the center of the plaza, under a dusty linden tree that had been old when [NOMBRE_ANONIMIZADO] s grandmother was young.
findings.claim: Introduces a grandmother of [NOMBRE_ANONIMIZADO] s on this side of the hill. The Bible s family entry is his parents plus Marcos the grandfather; the only grandmother in the book is Elena s, on the far side, unmet.
findings.fix: Cut the genealogy: a dusty linden tree that had been old for as long as anyone could remember.
